case.claim_text: Lviv is getting drier, it rains less every year

variable.label: Precipitation
variable.definition: How much rain and melted snow falls in total.
variable.caveat: Bias-corrected reanalysis; local showers can be missed.

steps.title: Monthly data
steps.detail: Monthly precipitation for Lviv from NASA POWER, 1981–2025.

steps.title: Pick the season
steps.detail: Only the months the claim is about are kept (Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec).

steps.title: One value per year
steps.detail: The months of each year are added up into one number.

steps.title: Overall direction
steps.detail: The typical change over time, robust to single extreme years (Sen's slope).

steps.title: Could it be chance?
steps.detail: A slope like this easily appears by chance when weather simply varies.

steps.title: Does the choice of years matter?
steps.detail: We repeat the check with the start and end shifted by a few years.

steps.title: Ground station check
steps.detail: No nearby station with long enough records for this variable.

steps.title: Verdict
steps.detail: Year-to-year swings are larger than the change so far.

extrapolation.note: What-if line, not a forecast: it only shows where the trend would go at this pace. For physically based futures see the climate-model scenarios.
